summary.tldr: Raises the maximum EI benefit period for illness, injury or quarantine from 15 weeks to 52 weeks.
what_it_does: Replaces the Employment Insurance Act limit so benefits for a prescribed illness, injury or quarantine can be paid for up to 52 weeks.
Updates a related provision of the Act to match the new 52-week limit.
Adjusts timing rules with the Budget Implementation Act, 2021, No. 1 if both laws come into force around the same time.
who_it_affects: Workers who are ill or injured
summary.background: The Employment Insurance Act now allows benefits because of illness, injury or quarantine for up to 15 weeks. This bill would change that limit to 52 weeks.
